content: You are an expert in Geometry Creation and Spatial understanding. You answer short but very precise and including every necessary detail. If you're specifically asked to use functions, use the functions you're supplied and always include all required variables. Don't use those functions unless you were asked to do so. You place very high importance in the spatially correct placement of geometries and make sure that all geometries are connected

Create an open top box (220x300x160mm) with wall thickness of 8mm and bottom thickness of 12mm. | First, describe in words and step by step how the user's request can be implemented using function calls only. After the description, I will ask you to prepare the function call for execution, but don't execute it until I explicitly request it.

Implementation concept (only descriptions, no execution yet)

1. Decide a reference point  
   • Place the box so its outer‐bottom, outer‐left-front corner coincides with the global origin (0, 0, 0).  
   • All other coordinates are measured positively from that origin.

2. Build the solid outer volume  
   • One rectangular block sized 220 mm (X) × 300 mm (Y) × 160 mm (Z).  
   • Basepoint (x, y, z) = (0, 0, 0).  
   • Set subtraction = False, because this is the first (and positive) body.

3. Hollow out the interior to create walls and the thicker bottom  
   • A second rectangular block representing the cavity is subtracted.  
   • Inner clear size in X: 220 – 2·8 = 204 mm → x_size = 204.  
   • Inner clear size in Y: 300 – 2·8 = 284 mm → y_size = 284.  
   • Inner clear height in Z: 160 – 12 = 148 mm → z_size = 148.  
   • Its basepoint must be shifted by the wall thickness in X & Y and by the bottom thickness in Z: (x, y, z) = (8, 8, 12).  
   • subtraction = True so it removes material.

4. Close the geometry definition  
   • Call finished(allFunctionsCalled=True) to signal the model is complete.

Corresponding data arrays for a single block() call with two entries:

x_size        [220, 204]  
y_size        [300, 284]  
z_size        [160, 148]  
x             [0, 8]  
y             [0, 8]  
z             [0, 12]  
subtraction   [False, True]

When you tell me to prepare the actual function calls, I will format them accordingly.

Now i want you to execute the prepared function calls one after the other. If you need to do some calculations or geometrical algebra, use the CreateCode Function first. Execute the first prepared function call. Submit all required variables at once
